All other candidates either refer to different products (e.g., "Lumina Smart Lamp," "Zenith Pro Laptop"), unrelated metrics (e.g., warranty duration, power rating), or memory texts that do not mention the battery duration of Lumina Tab 10.

Thus, the candidate that satisfies the condition is **e_2168ce**. No other candidate satisfies it, so the only valid item is this one.

```json

  "groups": [

        {
          "condition": "battery operation duration ≥ 15 hours",
```
